title: Vocabulary: Synonyms, Antonyms and Unfamiliar Phrases in Context

questions.question: Maya was reluctant to enter the dark cave. What does reluctant mean?
questions.explanation: Reluctant means you do not really want to do something.

questions.question: During the drought, clean water became scarce. Which word is the opposite of scarce?
questions.explanation: Scarce means there is very little of something. Abundant means there is plenty.

questions.question: The climbers crossed a precarious bridge above the gorge. What does precarious mean?
questions.explanation: Precarious describes something unsafe or likely to go wrong.

questions.question: Leo was so engrossed in his book that he did not hear the bell. What does engrossed mean?
questions.explanation: Engrossed means giving something all your attention.

questions.question: Her apology sounded sincere. Which word has the closest meaning to sincere?
questions.explanation: Sincere means honest and truly meant, so genuine is the closest match.

questions.question: When both paths disappeared in the fog, Arun was at a loss. What does at a loss mean?
questions.explanation: To be at a loss means to feel puzzled and not know what to do next.

questions.question: The engineer said the plan was feasible. What does feasible mean?
questions.explanation: Feasible means something can realistically be done.

questions.question: After the final whistle, the crowd dispersed. What does dispersed mean?
questions.explanation: Dispersed means spread out or moved away in different directions.

questions.question: The stray dog became hostile when the man approached. What does hostile mean?
questions.explanation: Hostile means unfriendly and possibly ready to attack.

questions.question: The instructions were ambiguous, so different pupils understood them differently. What does ambiguous mean?
options: Unclear or open to more than one meaning
questions.answer: Unclear or open to more than one meaning
questions.explanation: Ambiguous language is unclear because it can be understood in more than one way.
